Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Weird timing issue, of course another corner case that only I'll ever
think of:

If I play Grasp the Ghostly, and get, say, a Bomb, out of someone else's
ash heap, and then I use that bomb, does it go back to the Ash Heap when
it is burned? Or is it removed from the game since it loses all its
Pathos counters as it hits the ash heap?

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
More Grasp the Ghostly questions:
What happens if the Grasped equipment gets stolen? During whose untap
phase do the Pathos counters get removed?

And, what happens if you Grasp a Crimson Sentinel and it changes control
to another minion?
The last sentence says "Remove all counters from this card if another minion
gains control of it." It doesn't say "soul counters." So do the Pathos
counters go too?

Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
"Jozxyqk" <jfeu...@eecs.tufts.edu> wrote in message news:TGyZ9.67581$_s4.37434@rwcrnsc54...

> More Grasp the Ghostly questions:
> What happens if the Grasped equipment gets stolen? During whose untap
> phase do the Pathos counters get removed?

The untap phase of the Methuselah who played the Grasp. It's not a
card that goes in play, so its effects are fully defined when it is
played, and one of its ongoing effects tells you (the playing Meth)
to remove Pathos counters during your untap phases.

> And, what happens if you Grasp a Crimson Sentinel and it changes control
> to another minion?
> The last sentence says "Remove all counters from this card if another minion
> gains control of it." It doesn't say "soul counters." So do the Pathos
> counters go too?

Online cardtext for Crimson Sentinel does say "remove all soul
counters". That should match the SW printing if it's correct,
so Pathos counters wouldn't go. :-)

Not official answers, of course, but I'm pretty sure these are
right.

I wasn't so sure about the Bomb/ash heap/remove from game
question, but found a previous answer to it on Google: If a
Grasped equipment is burned before running out of Pathos
counters, the "remove from game" effect will not follow it
to the ash heap.

http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=3BB84CCF.C9C9E633%40white-wolf.com

Josh
